input: Take a one-day cheese making workshop nearby

gold.taskTitle: Find and attend a local cheese making workshop
gold.taskDescription: The user wants to take a one-day cheese making workshop at a nearby location.

questions.title: What city or region are you located in?
questions.description: Identify the user's location to find nearby workshops.

questions.title: Do you have a target date or month in mind?
questions.description: Determine the user's preferred timing for attending the workshop.

questions.title: What is your current level of cheese making experience?
questions.description: Understand whether the user is a complete beginner or has some prior knowledge.

questions.title: Are there specific types of cheese you want to learn to make?
questions.description: Find out if the user has a preference such as mozzarella, cheddar, brie, or goat cheese.

questions.title: What is your budget for the workshop fee?
questions.description: Understand the user's spending limit to filter suitable options.

questions.title: How far are you willing to travel to the workshop?
questions.description: Define the maximum acceptable travel distance or time from the user's location.

questions.title: Do you have any dietary restrictions affecting the cheeses made?
questions.description: Check for restrictions such as lactose intolerance, vegan preferences, or nut allergies relevant to workshop activities.
